text:
alex_infra: Heads-up — we're onboarding a new seed org (sparrow) and need p4d/p5/g5 entitlement increases in eu-west-13. They want dedicated capacity for initial pilot: 6 x p5, 4 x p4d, 8 x g5 across 2 AZs. Also need ENI and NATGW headroom, subnet sizing guidance, and an IPv6 fallback plan. Can infra own the quota requests?

maria_cloudops: @alex_infra got it. Please paste the account IDs + org ID and preferred AZ affinity (if any). We also need expected sustained vCPU and a short justification for business case when we open support cases. Any warm-pool / reserved capacity ask?

alex_infra: account: 987654321098, org: o-1a2b3c4d. Preferred AZs: eu-west-13a + eu-west-13b to keep traffic local. Sustained estimate: ~1.2M vCPU-hours/month initially (pilot), concurrency ~120 simultaneous jobs. Warm pool: yes — want 2 warm p5 instances to reduce cold-starts. Justification: enterprise pilot, low-latency inference for customers in region, SLA-backed testing.

raj_eng: Quick Q — do we need EFA on p4d nodes for batching? Also will ECR image pulls burst the VPC NATGW? We should request additional EIP/NATGW throughput or use VPC endpoints.

maria_cloudops: Good call. Ask product to switch to VPC gateway endpoints for ECR (recommended). For NATGW we can request a larger bandwidth / additional NAT gateways in the ticket. For EFA, mark it as required for p4d in the request body.

alex_infra: Drafted the support-case body below — can one of you paste when opening cases?

```
Subject: Service quota increase + network limits for account 987654321098 (eu-west-13)
Body:
- Account ID: 987654321098
- Org: o-1a2b3c4d
- Region: eu-west-13
- Resources requested:
  * p5 instances (ami-type/burst): increase quota to 6 Concurrent Instances
  * p4d instances: increase quota to 4 Concurrent Instances (EFA enabled)
  * g5 instances: increase quota to 8 Concurrent Instances
  * Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs): +150
  * IPv4 private IPs per ENI / subnet guidance: request additional subnet / bigger CIDR as needed
  * NAT Gateway throughput: request support for additional NAT capacity or 2x NATGWs
  * VPC endpoints: please approve creation of com.amazonaws.ecr and S3 gateway endpoints
- Justification: pilot for low-latency LLM inference, dedicated capacity, SLA testing. Will scale to prod after 8 weeks.
- Preferred AZs: eu-west-13a, eu-west-13b
- Contact: alex_infra@redwood.ai, maria_cloudops@redwood.ai
```

maria_cloudops: I'm going to open three tickets: EC2 service quotas (p5/p4d/g5), VPC quota (ENI/IPs), and NAT/EIP throughput. I'll post the case numbers here.

sre-bot: [automation] Created support case EC2-98761234 for instance quotas (p5/p4d/g5) — expected response 24-72h.

maria_cloudops: Case numbers: EC2-98761234 (instances), VPC-98761235 (ENIs/IPs), NET-98761236 (NAT/EIP). Added notes to request EFA, ECR endpoint, and IPv6 fallback route table.

raj_eng: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) Can we pin instance families for the warm pool? 2) Please add a request for ephemeral ENI increase per AZ — we hit limits during scale tests.

alex_infra: Added warm-pool note and asked for per-AZ ENI headroom + automated fallback to g5 if p5 capacity not available. Also requested cost estimate from procurement for monthly reserved capacity in eu-west-13.

maria_cloudops: I'll coordinate with procurement. If AWS asks for contact, we will route them to me. Will update here when any quota moves or if they require VPC peering / route adjustments.

sre-bot: [automation] Noted participants: alex_infra, maria_cloudops, raj_eng. Monitoring message thread for quota updates.

alex_infra: thanks — please ping if they ask for additional network topology diagrams. :thumbsup:
